messages:
jessica: Customer Omega reported repeated "Invalid JSON in structured mode" errors when sending batch orders. Happening intermittently since yesterday. Ticket #5478 created.

jessica: Error in support log: "ParseError: Unexpected token '}' at position 132"

sahil: Can you paste the original prompt and the mode flags? Suspect streaming split across token boundaries.

jessica: Sending a redacted cURL repro we used (customer supplied):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-compat-1","mode":"structured_json","prompt":"<large prompt>","max_tokens":1024}'
```

mike: Any latency or retry spikes around the failure windows? Retries could cause duplicate token charges and partial payloads.

jessica: Support traces show a 502 from gateway at 2024-06-18T14:07:12Z then client retried twice. Billing shows an unexplained +400 token delta.

tom: Can you paste the exact model output chunk that failed to parse? Need to see partial/invalid object cases.

jessica: Logged raw chunk from streaming response (as captured):
```json
{"orders":[{"item_id":null,"qty":2},{"temp_id":"t-123","qty":1}],"cursor":123}
```

sahil: Ok — two related issues here: first order has item_id:null (our schema requires a string); second order uses an extra key temp_id instead of item_id. Parser currently assumes items[].item_id exists and even relies on ordering for downstream mapping. Model output drift + token-splits explains the ParseError.

tom: Repro steps I used locally: 1) send structured_json with a prompt that requests multiple items; 2) set max_tokens low and enable streaming to force mid-object token boundaries; 3) observe truncated/partial objects and occasional extra keys when model hallucinates a placeholder key.

tom: Short-term mitigation ideas: update parser to be tolerant of extra keys and to treat item_id null as missing (attempt fallback to temp_id). Also ask generation policy: instruct the model to emit a sentinel when an ID is unknown, e.g. "item_id": "MISSING".

mike: Customer-facing fix suggestion: add a validation layer that rejects malformed structured outputs with a clear 4xx error and human-readable message. That prevents clients from silently accepting bad items and reduces surprise billing.

jessica: Customer asked for ETA — marking as high priority. Any chance the gateway can block malformed final payloads from being counted for billing? :thinking_face:

sahil: We can prototype a lightweight pre-parse on the gateway: collect stream until final chunk, run a cheap JSON sanity + required-key check, and if final parse fails mark the request as failed with 422 and stop further billing commit. Need to coordinate with billing policy (PM/legal).

mike: I'll own PM discussion for billing/UX. Meanwhile: engineering quick wins — grammar prompt update + parser fallback.

jessica: Action items:
- tom: add parser fallback and tolerate extra keys (eng)
- sahil: prototype gateway pre-parse fail path (infra)
- mike: update docs + draft customer comms (product)
- jessica: provide interim workaround and suggest client-side retry logic (support)

jessica: tagging folks @tom @sahil @mike
ci-bot: ticket #5478 updated: priority -> P1; assigned -> tom

jessica: Thanks — will update customer after tom/sahil confirm ETA :thumbsup:
